field: ecological resilience, social-ecological systems, regime shifts
public_contact_or_submission: online submission portal with managing-editor contact
why_relevant: the journal that published Walker, Holling, Carpenter and Kinzig 2004; explicit data and code availability statement and blind peer review make it a ground-visible venue for an evidence-shape claim
notes: registration and login required; publication fee applies with waivers; check current special features before submitting

public_contact_or_submission: public Contact Us page and annual-meeting abstract submission
why_relevant: largest ecology society; seven journals and an annual meeting with open abstract calls; a legitimate route to readers who can refute an evidence claim
notes: homepage lists the 2027 meeting abstract call and ECOLOG-L, a free opt-in listserv; use the public channels, not personal staff addresses

why_relevant: long-standing opt-in ecology listserv; a public channel for asking what readers would count as a failure of an evidence shape
notes: listed on the ESA homepage; post one-to-one questions, never a bulk send

public_contact_or_submission: public Submissions and Contact pages under About
why_relevant: public submission and contact routes on a site dedicated to resilience; reaches practitioners as well as researchers
notes: site is a program of Post Carbon Institute; use the About > Submissions route, and state the refuter in the note

organization: IPBES (Intergovernmental Science-Policy Platform on Biodiversity and Ecosystem Services)
public_contact_or_submission: public contact information and stakeholder meetings
why_relevant: runs global and regional assessments of biodiversity and ecosystem services; public stakeholder notifications and an open contact route
notes: use the public contact information and opt-in stakeholder meetings; it is a policy assessment body, not a journal

organization: Resilience Alliance (publisher of Ecology and Society)
public_contact_or_submission: public journal contact route through Ecology and Society
why_relevant: the nonprofit publisher whose open-access journal carries the foundational resilience definitions; a second institutional entry point distinct from the submission portal
notes: registered 501(c)(3); route claims through the public journal contact, not personal editorial addresses
